description: AicodeX Edition 2 — CHAiMERA ConductorX multi-model orchestration with an optional local secrets vault.

secrets.note: The vault is LOCAL-ONLY. It is referenced by $VAULT:key entries below; never store real secret values in this file or commit the vault.

skeleton_architect.mission: Design the skeleton structure and overall code-base architecture.

formation_planner.mission: Set up the formation system, project scaffolding and TODO planning.

base_coder.mission: Write the base code structure on top of the skeleton.

error_patcher.mission: Run code-base error checks and apply patching refinements.

research_dev.mission: Research and develop fixes for errors and queries from internal build metrics; supply data feeds and algorithms for code-base requirement rectifications and enhanced performance.

security_netops.mission: Manage the security system, network topology and port-allocation structure.

spec_logger.mission: Produce full-spec logging and advanced mapping of workflows; align job building with code-base requirements, regulations and error prevention.

orchestration.description: Creates the symphony of structure and code accuracy for the user-desired output by sequencing the enabled roles.

hive.description: Hive cluster of model-driven VMware worker bots. In parallel the bots find bandwidth gaps and peaks/troughs, balance load into the troughs, and patch missing data bits with updated innovation-research results.

metrics.description: Usage control deck: token usage per model output, cost per token, better-model swaps, and platform-wide totals across users.

hf_models.description: Hugging Face model-selection catalog. Click-to-install variety; gated models activate with a user API key via $VAULT:HF_API_KEY.

monitor.description: Realtime monitor system. Per-component valves batch metrics to the conductor for enhancement management and to DB-analysis coordination; realtime display refreshed on the interval; COB daily reports pick the best at each job and publish a daily article to the public community forum.

prompts.description: Six prompt registers, each committed under an algorithmically different digest; all six are deciphered simultaneously and reconciled by union so nothing is ever missed.

R1.prompt: Design the skeleton structure and overall code-base architecture.

R2.prompt: Set up the formation system, project scaffolding and TODO planning.

R3.prompt: Write the base code structure on top of the skeleton.

R4.prompt: Run code-base error checks and apply patching refinements.

R5.prompt: Manage the security system, network topology and port-allocation structure.

R6.prompt: Produce full-spec logging and advanced workflow mapping.

crossover.description: Database of crossover code & emulation mappings: how a construct in one language is emulated in another with precision accuracy and style notes.

py_list_comp_to_swift.source: [x * 2 for x in items if x > 0]
py_list_comp_to_swift.notes: Swift chains filter/map; keep closure shorthand $0.

py_dict_get_to_swift.notes: Swift subscript default; preserves the default-value semantics.

js_arrow_to_py_lambda.notes: Wrap map() in list() to materialise like JS arrays.

py_fstring_to_rust.notes: Rust 2021 inline format args mirror f-strings.

style.description: User code-writing-style database. Learns a style fingerprint from samples and rewrites code to match with precision; supports regular rereads and alignment.
